---
params:
  area_code: "E92000001"
  area_name: "England"
  selected_topic: "Smoking"
  page_title: "title"
  data_name: "health_trends_data.rds"

title: "`r params$page_title`"

format:
  html:
    page-layout: full
    embed-resources: true
    anchor-sections: false
    css: www/styles.css
    lang: en
    grid-layout:
      body: 760px
    
template: www/HTS.template

execute:
  echo: false

---

```{r}
#| warnings: false
#| message: false
#| output: false

area_code <- params$area_code
area_name <- params$area_name

# Read in data file from the output folder (output_path in the config)
file_path <- healthtrends:::get_data_path(params$data_name)

all_data <- readr::read_rds(file_path)

# Get list of indicators associated with topic depending on area type
topic_inds <- healthtrends:::get_indicators(
  data_file = file_path,
  area_code = area_code
) |>
  dplyr::filter(TopicName %in% params$selected_topic) |>
  dplyr::pull(IndicatorID)

topic_data <- all_data |>
  dplyr::filter(
    AreaCode == area_code,
    IndicatorID %in% topic_inds
  )

# keep only indicators with data for this area, in IndicatorOrder (the order
# get_indicators() returns) so the charts match the table of contents
topic_inds <- topic_inds[topic_inds %in% topic_data$IndicatorID]
```

::: {.grid}
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-sm-3}

```{r sidebar}
#| results: asis

# Get list of topics
topics <- healthtrends:::get_indicator_csv(as_df = TRUE)

sidebar_list <- c("Overview", unique(topics$TopicName), "About")

# Create sidebar
healthtrends:::html_sidebar(sidebar_list, params$selected_topic, area_name)
```

:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-sm-9}

```{r title}
#| results: asis
# title with dropdown

# get all area names, ordered England > Region > UTLA
# (alphabetical within each tier), matching the AreaCode geography prefixes
# used elsewhere in the package
all_area_names <- all_data |>
  dplyr::distinct(AreaCode, AreaName) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    area_rank = dplyr::case_when(
      stringr::str_sub(AreaCode, 1, 3) == "E92" ~ 1L, # England
      stringr::str_sub(AreaCode, 1, 3) == "E12" ~ 2L, # Region
      TRUE ~ 3L                                       # UTLA
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(area_rank, AreaName) |>
  dplyr::pull(AreaName)

healthtrends:::html_title_dropdown(area_name, all_area_names, params$selected_topic)

cat(
  paste0(
    '<p class="lead">This page presents information about trends in indicators',
    " related to ",
    stringr::str_to_lower(params$selected_topic), ".</p>"
  )
)
```

```{r toc}
#| results: asis
# table of contents

# Get names of all charts to add to subnav list
chart_names <- topic_data |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    topics,
    by = "IndicatorID"
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(IndicatorName, IndicatorOrder) |>
  dplyr::distinct() |>
  dplyr::arrange(IndicatorOrder) |>
  dplyr::pull(IndicatorName)

# Create table of contents
healthtrends:::html_toc(
  params$selected_topic,
  area_name,
  section_titles = chart_names
)
```

```{r}
#| include: false
#| error: false
#| warning: false
# create tile for each topic
output <- NULL

for (i in seq_along(topic_inds)) {
  output <- c(
    output,
    knitr::knit_child("healthtrendsfiles/Quarto_extracts/_details_chunk.qmd")
  )
}
```

`r paste(output, collapse = "\n")`
